The following dependencies could not be confirmed to be widely-used. Such dependencies must instead be included non-minified in the source so they can be reviewed directly. A build dependency cannot be included that way. Please replace it with a widely-used equivalent, or remove it from the submitted source archive if it is not strictly needed to reproduce the shipped add-on. Reviewers should only be asked to install tools the wider community has vetted.
Read more: https://webextension-api.thunderbird.net/en/mv3/guides/sourceCodeSubmission.html

This applies to build dependencies too, since the reviewer installs and runs them to reproduce your build. Re-declare each as an npm package or a GitHub source, or, for a library you bundle, include its non-minified source in the archive so it can be reviewed directly.
